en: I wonder when we'll finally be\nable to return to Earth.
To be honest, I have children\nwaiting for me back on Earth.
Wait, oh, no! I didn't give birth\nto them! I'm still single!!
Actually, I volunteer at a\nfacility on Earth to look after\nchildren.
I just can't stop worrying about\nthem...
I miss them all so much... I\nwonder how they're doing right\nnow...
Until I boarded this ship, I'd\nonly ever been to my home\nplanet and Earth.
So, there's a part of me that's\nactually quite enjoying this\njourney.
Was that a bit insensitive? I'm\nsorry.
But... I have a feeling that\nyou're enjoying this journey\ntoo, Evelysse.
What makes you think that?
You seem to have so many\nthings on your mind.
It's because she's in love with\nme.
I don't have any proof... but my\nintuition is usually spot on.
I mean, I'm a Girl, so of course I\nhave plenty of worries.
Like how I want to lose the fat\nin my lower cheeks... or do\nsomething about my thighs...
But whenever I tell a guy, they\njust say they prefer it when a\ngirl is a little chubby!
Even though they don't actually\nmean it!! Captain, you're such\nan idiot!!!
I-is that so...? Ahahaha,\nhahahaha...
Sometimes the kindest thing to\ndo is just leave it alone.
This is a bit random, but...
Didn't your stomach growl\nduring the battle?
You see, I actually love\ncooking!
That's why I'm always really\nworried about whether the\npeople around me are hungry.
You know, things made by\nautomatic cookers are tasty,\nbut they lack character.
After a battle, when you're all\nsweaty, something a bit saltier\njust tastes better, right?
That kind of adjustment is\nhard for a machine, don't you\nthink?
If there's anything you want to\neat, just let me know. I'll cook\nup something special!
I wonder how the children are\ndoing...
Sorry, I zoned out for a\nsecond. I just started thinking\nabout Earth.
You know, I told you\nbefore―about the shelter for\nwar orphans on Earth.
The children there are around\nten years old now.
I had already lost my parents\nby the time I was that age...
So I guess I just understand\nthe loneliness those kids feel.
But look! I grew up just fine\nand full of energy!
I know the children will be okay\ntoo.
I just... I just really want to see\nthem... that's all...
You've been through a lot.
I'm sure those children want to\nsee you too.
You're their mother, Miki.
Oh, it wasn't that much of a\nstruggle, really.

On our planet, it wasn't
uncommon for children to be
orphans or for parents to lose
their children...
But I do find myself imagining\nwhat my own mother would say\nto me at times like this.
Thank you for caring about me.
...Stop it! Don't say things like\nthat!
Now I'm just getting more and\nmore homesick!!
I want to see those children\nright now!!
Let's go home quickly! To\nEarth! Right now!!
Ugh, do I really seem that\nmeddlesome?
The companions I was traveling\nwith until recently used to tell\nme that all the time...
I don't need a 40-year-old\nchild who's a womanizer and a\nhandful!
I mentioned before that I lost\nmy parents when I was little,\nright?
Ah, please don't get all gloomy.
I wasn't some pitiful child,\nbelieve me.

Around the same time my
parents passed away, my
childhood friend's mother died
too.

My childhood friend was a
Boy... well, "child" is a loose
term, since he was older than
me.
...I grew up with him as if we\nwere real siblings.

Well, for my part... I wasn't
exactly happy about becoming
siblings. It was more...
complicated...
Anyway, enough about that!!
He always praised me, saying\nthat my cooking was even\nbetter than his mother's...
My mother was actually a\nwonderful cook.
She created a place where I\nbelonged. She really was like a\nsecond family to me.
That's why I know.
That the bond between a\nparent and child can be based\non more than just blood.
Fighting helps clear the head a\nbit, doesn't it? Like a way to\nblow off steam.
See, lately I've been thinking about the\nchildren at the facilities on Earth and\nthe parents I lost when I was young...
And whenever I do, I get this\nrestless feeling.

It's like being on the verge of
remembering something, but
not quite. Like a sneeze that
won't come out.
It feels as if I'm forgetting\nsomething very important\nabout my mother...

Memories from when I was a
small child are so vague; trying
to recall them is like trying to
grasp a cloud...
Do you ever feel that way,\nCaptain?
I really understand that feeling.
I don't dwell on the past.
When I was little, I was famous\nfor being a child prodigy.
Right?!
In my case, I usually blow off\naccumulated stress by cooking.
But lately, I've thought that\nfighting is pretty great too! So\nplease, let me go wild!
Is that so? Maybe I should do\nthe same.
But once I start worrying about\nit, I just can't stop!
Is that how it was?!
I know a woman who's just like\nthat.
But that person... is a bit\neccentric.
Her taste in clothes... and her\ntaste in romance...
Could it be that you're like that\ntoo, Captain...
N-no way, that can't be true!\nAhahaha, ahahahaha...
What? There was a suspicious\nperson running wild in the\nkitchen last night!?
U-um, well... I don't think it's\npossible for anyone from the\noutside to get in.
Could it be that the AI ran out\nof machine oil and was looking\nfor cooking oil in the kitchen?
Oh, so this was a report from\nthe AI... In that case, um...
Ugh, I'm sorry. I'm the culprit...

Last night, I was thinking about
my mother again―the things I
can't remember―and I couldn't
sleep...

I thought if I moved my body
and got tired, I'd be able to
sleep, so I spent the night
kneading pie crust.
I'm sorry for causing such a\nstir...
I mean, well... choosing pie just\nbecause I wanted to move my\nbody might be a bit weird...
But for some reason, at the\ntime, I just thought, "This is it!"
Since it's a dish I normally\nnever make,
I actually made it with a\nmindset of, "I hope it fails!"...
Would you like to come try\nsome later? ...I can't guarantee\nthe taste, though...
I'd love to come try some.
I'm not a fan of pie.
My last will and testament says\nthat pie is the only thing I can't\nstand.
I made plenty, so please help\nyourself!
After all, men who eat a lot are\njust so cool!
...Maybe I should prepare a few\nother things too.
Quite a few people don't like\nthings that are too crumbly.
In that case, maybe I'll try\nmaking something that goes\ndown easier?
Pudding or jelly might be a\ngood idea.
What on earth is in your will!?
That's fine. I wouldn't want to\neat something cooked in a\nlate-night frenzy either.
I'll just eat it myself. There are\n16 plates, but I'm not giving\nany to you, Captain.
Listen to this, Captain!
I've become totally obsessed\nwith making pies since then.\nAnd get this!
It's Evelysse! Evelysse herself\nis helping me!
Surprising, right!? Plus, she's\nactually quite a natural at it.
It really made me realize that\nEvelysse is a girl after all!

I'm thinking of trying to get
some romantic gossip out of
her next time while we make
pies.
Even if you're curious, I won't\ntell you! It's a maiden's secret.

While I was making pies with
Evelysse... I felt like something
like this happened a long time
ago.
Like I was baking pies with\nsomeone...
And then, I remembered!
I love the pies my mother used\nto make, and we often baked\nthem together.
I probably wasn't much help,\nbut...
My mother always praised me.
That's why I loved those pies\neven more.
The reason I avoided baking\nand didn't want to eat them...
Was because I didn't want any\npie other than my mother's.
While I felt that way, I ended\nup forgetting so many things...
I'm glad I remembered.
From now on, I'm going to bake\nas many pies as I can!

I know it's a bit boastful, but
they're actually quite delicious.
You'll have to try some with me
sometime.
One batch of the Sauvesta\nfamily's special pies, coming\nright up!!
Eat them while they're hot!
Is it tasty? I'm so glad! I was\nso nervous that you might tell\nme it tasted bad.
There are refills, so please, eat\nas much as you like.
There's something else I\nremembered about my mother.
She used to say this all the\ntime.

Just having a full stomach is\nenough to make you happy.	machine
